notes: v2.123 (2026-11-21, afternoon run): 122nd tower 'Candle' (a yellow flame over a striped red/green candle on a wide blue dish — a candle silhouette to demolish, 25 blocks, 6 clusters sizes 4/3/3/3/5/7, all 4 colours, no singletons, 0 canonical duplicates) + 119th co-play prompt (push a battery candle or push-button light on saying 'on… glow!', watch the soft light together, push again for 'off… dark!' — on and off is the game; battery lights only, no real flames, grown-up keeps batteries tucked away). Light/glow research: a soft glow in a dim room is high-contrast sensory input that builds visual tracking and focus; pushing a light on/off is instant cause-and-effect ('I did that!') even under-ones can do; dim-room glow play is a calming wind-down, and real flames are never the prop.
